_meta.description: Citations registry for the Mmnd Observatory. Each entry is a primary source for a factual claim made on the synthesis page, timeline, or source cards. Cite-keys are referenced inline as superscript links. To cite a new claim, add an entry and reference its key. 'provenance' field documents the verification status: 'verified' (arXiv/DOI/journal confirmed), 'canonical-blog' (official blog post, no peer-reviewed paper), 'classical' (predates digital identifiers, standard reference given), 'observatory-internal' (concept documented in the observatory's own deep-dive, no external source).
